response.sql: SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, COUNT(*) / AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The total members across all groups is the count of members with a non-null link_to_major (members without a major are excluded from the denominator too).
Members with an empty-string major id would count as a group; only NULL is treated as having no major.
Ties in the ratio are broken arbitrarily.
